Thanks for the report! This was addressed in a prior fix — appmsg attachment handling (Word, Excel, PDF from the WeCom AI Bot) is already implemented on `main` and has shipped since **v2026.4.13**.

- **Commit:** `cf53e2676` — `fix(wecom): handle appmsg attachments (PDF/Word/Excel) from WeCom AI Bot`
- **Code:** `gateway/platforms/wecom.py` lines 698–704 explicitly handle `msgtype="appmsg"` and route `file`/`image` sub-payloads into the agent's media context.
- **Release:** Shipped in `v2026.4.13`; current `main` (as of `v2026.4.23`) includes it.

If you ran `hermes update` and still don't see it working, double-check that your running instance actually restarted after the update (gateway processes need a full restart to pick up new code). If you're still seeing the issue after a clean restart on `v2026.4.13` or later, please reopen with a reproduction log.
